Permission denied on the Docker socket. On the host, add your SSH user to the docker group (sudo usermod -aG docker <user>), then log out and back in — or connect as a user that is already in the docker group. Afterwards use \"Retest transport\" on this host.

Permission denied on the Podman socket. Rootless Podman uses a per-user socket, so connect over SSH as the user that owns it and enable it with \"systemctl --user enable --now podman.socket\"; for the rootful socket connect as root instead. Afterwards use \"Retest transport\" on this host.

Permission denied on the Incus socket. On the host, add your SSH user to the incus-admin group (sudo usermod -aG incus-admin <user>), then log out and back in — or connect as a user that is already in that group. Afterwards use \"Retest transport\" on this host.

Permission denied on the LXD socket. On the host, add your SSH user to the lxd group (sudo usermod -aG lxd <user>), then log out and back in — or connect as a user that is already in that group. Afterwards use \"Retest transport\" on this host.

The SSH server refused the unix-socket forward. Ensure sshd_config has BOTH AllowTcpForwarding yes AND AllowStreamLocalForwarding yes (AllowTcpForwarding no silently blocks socket forwards too), then restart sshd and use \"Retest transport\".
The SSH server refused the TCP forward to the endpoint. Ensure sshd_config has AllowTcpForwarding yes and that the address is reachable from the host, then use \"Retest transport\".

A backup always contains everything, so this file will expose in readable form:

• Connection passwords
• Container host and registry credentials

Anyone who obtains this file can read every one of them. There is no password on it and no way to revoke it after it leaves your device.

TabSSH — a modern SSH client for Android.

Getting started:
• Tap + to add a new connection
• Long-press a connection for more options
• Swipe left or right to move between tabs
• Swipe in from the left edge, or tap the menu button, to open navigation

Features:
• Browser-style SSH tabs
• SSH key management
• Port forwarding
• SFTP file transfer
• Performance monitoring
• Hypervisor and container management

More help is available on the project website.

Native components (%1$s):
• Tor %2$s — %3$s
• Mosh %4$s — %5$s
• Tor crypto: OpenSSL %6$s, libevent %7$s, zlib %8$s
• Terminal: Termux %9$s
• Fonts: %10$s

Available Tasker Actions:

📱 CONNECT
Connect to SSH server
Extras: connection_id or connection_name

📴 DISCONNECT
Disconnect from server
Extras: connection_id or connection_name

⌨️ SEND_COMMAND
Execute command
Extras: connection_id/name, command, wait_for_result, timeout_ms

🔑 SEND_KEYS
Send key sequence
Extras: connection_id/name, keys

Examples:
- Keys: "Enter", "Tab", "Ctrl+C"
- Command: "ls -la" with wait_for_result=true

Broadcast Events:

✅ CONNECTED
Broadcast when connection established
Extras: connection_id, connection_name

❌ DISCONNECTED
Broadcast when connection closed
Extras: connection_id, connection_name

📊 COMMAND_RESULT
Broadcast when a command completes
Extras: connection_id, connection_name, command, status, result
result carries terminal output only when "Include Command Output in Broadcasts" is enabled; otherwise it mirrors status

⚠️ ERROR
Broadcast when error occurs
Extras: error

Use these in Tasker with Event → Intent Received
